section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Sole proprietors (enkeltpersonforetak): income tax
value: Net business income is part of general income, taxed at 22% after personfradrag; trygdeavgift and trinnskatt are charged on the calculated personal income (beregnet personinntekt)
note: Sole proprietors pay trygdeavgift at 10.8% instead of the 7.6% wage rate. The PAYE rate of 25% includes trygdeavgift: with an exemption from Norwegian national insurance it is 17.4%.
source_title: Skatteetaten: Personinntekt i enkeltpersonforetak
